title: Procurement ( Civil - Arch - MEP ) Comparison Sheet Signature Matrix
text:
Procurement ( Civil - Arch - MEP ) Comparison Sheet Signature Matrix - Comparison Sheet Signature Matrix
Approval workflow: Comparison Sheet Signature Matrix.

Steps: Procurement Eng. (Procurement Civil - Arch); Procurement Section Head; Cost Control Engineer ( Site ) Via email (Civil - Arch); DAM (Civil - Arch); Procurement Eng./ Technical Office Engineer (Procurement MEP); Procurement Manager/ MEP Technical Affairs Manager; MEP Deputy; Cost Control Engineer ( Site ) Via email (MEP); DAM (MEP); Planning & Cost HOD; PsM Signature; PsM Signature; VMO Manager Signature; PsM Signature; VMO Manager Signature; COO Signature; VP Signature; PsM Signature; VMO Manager Signature; COO Signature; CEO Signature.

Order of approval so far, first to last (each one signs after the one before it); the route then branches:
  1. Procurement Eng. (Procurement Civil - Arch)
  2. Procurement Section Head
  3. Cost Control Engineer ( Site ) Via email (Civil - Arch)
  After Cost Control Engineer ( Site ) Via email (Civil - Arch) the route branches; who signs next depends on the value, see Routing and Approval thresholds below.

Routing:
  - Procurement Eng. (Procurement Civil - Arch) -> Procurement Section Head
  - Procurement Section Head -> Cost Control Engineer ( Site ) Via email (Civil - Arch)
  - Cost Control Engineer ( Site ) Via email (Civil - Arch) -> DAM (Civil - Arch) [For Direct Award Projects Only.]
  - Cost Control Engineer ( Site ) Via email (Civil - Arch) -> Planning & Cost HOD [Competitive Projects]
  - DAM (Civil - Arch) -> Planning & Cost HOD
  - Procurement Eng./ Technical Office Engineer (Procurement MEP) -> Procurement Manager/ MEP Technical Affairs Manager
  - Procurement Manager/ MEP Technical Affairs Manager -> MEP Deputy
  - MEP Deputy -> Cost Control Engineer ( Site ) Via email (MEP)
  - Cost Control Engineer ( Site ) Via email (MEP) -> DAM (MEP) [For Direct Award Projects Only.]
  - Cost Control Engineer ( Site ) Via email (MEP) -> Planning & Cost HOD [Competitive Projects]
  - DAM (MEP) -> Planning & Cost HOD
  - Planning & Cost HOD -> PsM Signature [Less than 2M. Note: PsM approval is obtained up to 2M, in case CS is within budget. CC: Finance/CFO]
  - Planning & Cost HOD -> PsM Signature [2M-3M]
  - Planning & Cost HOD -> PsM Signature [3M-10M]
  - Planning & Cost HOD -> PsM Signature [Above 10M]
  - PsM Signature -> VMO Manager Signature
  - PsM Signature -> VMO Manager Signature
  - VMO Manager Signature -> COO Signature
  - COO Signature -> VP Signature
  - PsM Signature -> VMO Manager Signature
  - VMO Manager Signature -> COO Signature
  - COO Signature -> CEO Signature

Approval thresholds:
  - A purchase value of "2M-3M" requires approval by VMO Manager Signature. VMO Manager Signature approves at value: 2M-3M.
  - A purchase value of "3M-10M" requires approval by VP Signature. VP Signature approves at value: 3M-10M.
  - A purchase value of "Above 10M" requires approval by CEO Signature. CEO Signature approves at value: Above 10M.

Thresholds recorded on this page but not tied to this flow: Less than 2M -> PsM Signature

text:
Subcontract Agreement Signature Matrix - Apply Subcontracts (Civil, Arch, MEP)
Approval workflow: Apply Subcontracts (Civil, Arch, MEP).

Steps: Apply Subcontracts (Civil, Arch, MEP) (Initiate subcontract); Earthmoving HoD (if related); PM Signature (printed 'PM initials', amended by hand); Subcontractor Signature; MEP TAM initials; MEP Deputy initials; TAM/DAM initials; PsM initials (printed 'PsM signature', amended by hand); PM initials; Subcontractor signature; MEP TAM initials; TAM/DAM initials; MEP Manager initials; PsM initials; Operations Manager initials; COO initial; VP Signature; MEP TAM initials; TAM/DAM initials; MEP Manager initials; PsM initials; Contracts Dept. Initials; Subcontractor signature; Operations Manager initials; COO Initial; VP Signature; CEO Signature.

Routing:
  - Apply Subcontracts (Civil, Arch, MEP) (Initiate subcontract) -> Earthmoving HoD (if related) [if related]
  - Apply Subcontracts (Civil, Arch, MEP) (Initiate subcontract) -> PM Signature (printed 'PM initials', amended by hand) [Less than 500K - 500K struck through and amended by hand to 2M. Note: PsM approval is obtained up to 2M, in case S/C is within budget. If S/C is not within budget, COO approval is required. CC: Finance/CFO]
  - Apply Subcontracts (Civil, Arch, MEP) (Initiate subcontract) -> PM initials [More than 500K - printed figure; the opposite branch carries a handwritten amendment of 500K to 2M]
  - PM Signature (printed 'PM initials', amended by hand) -> Subcontractor Signature
  - Subcontractor Signature -> MEP TAM initials
  - MEP TAM initials -> MEP Deputy initials
  - MEP Deputy initials -> TAM/DAM initials
  - TAM/DAM initials -> PsM initials (printed 'PsM signature', amended by hand)
  - PM initials -> Subcontractor signature [500K to 4M - 500K struck through and amended by hand to 2M, giving 2M to 4M]
  - PM initials -> MEP TAM initials [More than 4M]
  - Subcontractor signature -> MEP TAM initials
  - MEP TAM initials -> TAM/DAM initials
  - TAM/DAM initials -> MEP Manager initials
  - MEP Manager initials -> PsM initials
  - PsM initials -> Operations Manager initials
  - Operations Manager initials -> COO initial
  - COO initial -> VP Signature
  - MEP TAM initials -> TAM/DAM initials
  - TAM/DAM initials -> MEP Manager initials
  - MEP Manager initials -> PsM initials
  - PsM initials -> Contracts Dept. Initials
  - Contracts Dept. Initials -> Subcontractor signature
  - Subcontractor signature -> Operations Manager initials
  - Operations Manager initials -> COO Initial
  - COO Initial -> VP Signature [From 4M to 6M]
  - COO Initial -> CEO Signature [Above 6M]

Thresholds recorded on this page but not tied to this flow: Apply Subcontracts: less than 500K, amended by hand to 2M -> PsM initials; Apply Subcontracts: 500K to 4M, amended by hand to 2M to 4M -> VP Signature; Apply Subcontracts: more than 4M, from 4M to 6M -> VP Signature; Apply Subcontracts: above 6M -> CEO Signature; Supply & Apply Subcontracts: less than 2M -> PsM Signature; Supply & Apply Subcontracts: 2M - 3M -> VMO Manager Signature; Supply & Apply Subcontracts: 3M - 10M -> VP Signature; Supply & Apply Subcontracts: above 10M -> CEO Signature
